note: Where every fact in this guide comes from. Trophy names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as published on Exophase and PSNProfiles on 18 November 2026; the two agree on every name, description and grade. PSN progress targets (the counts, such as 42 shooting range challenges) are from PSNProfiles. How-to detail is drawn from PowerPyx's GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 November 2026) and rewritten in our own words; where PowerPyx marks a trophy as not yet known, the guide says so. Hidden flags (28 of 55 hidden on PlayStation) are our reading of the list: story and side-character trophies and the cryptic one-liners are the hidden ones; the count matches the official 28. No Rockstar artwork or logo is used anywhere in this guide.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)
sources.note: The official trophy list as PlayStation publishes it: all 55 names, descriptions and grades, plus each trophy's earn rate. The list the kit's gate holds this guide to.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
sources.note: The same 55 names, descriptions and grades, plus PSN's progress target for each counted trophy (42 shooting range challenges, 250 stunts, 18 meditation spots, 500 profile actions, and the rest).

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.note: The launch guide that played the game (18 November 2026): difficulty 4/10, about 200 hours, one playthrough, no online trophies, no mission replay, cheats disable trophies; the only potentially missable trophy (Positive Mental Attitude, Chapter 1); the 100% checklist's lenient thresholds; and the per-trophy how-to detail this guide rewrites in its own words.

sources.name: Our own reading of the official descriptions
sources.note: For trophies PowerPyx marks as not yet known, and for the roadmap and missable flags, this guide works from the official descriptions alone and says so in the guide text — no method is invented and none is claimed as confirmed.
sources.short: Our own advice from the official description
